newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche says Invirase boosts AIDS treatment.
newsitem.headline: Roche says Invirase boosts AIDS treatment.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said a major study released today found that adding its drug Invirase to a standard two-drug treatment for AIDS significantly reduced the onset of the anti-immune disease.
A Roche statement said the findings emerged from a study dubbed SV-14604 that covered 3,485 patients from 22 countries between August 1994 and January 1997.

"Combining Invirase with Hivid (ddC) plus AZT delayed disease progression and prolonged survival in patients without or with limited prior anti-retroviral therepy by 50 percent...compared to patients starting therepy with Hivid and AZT alone," Roche said.
Roche said the study's findings would be submitted to regulatory authorities in order to update the product labeling of Invirase.
